knowledge_points.name: 家庭成员与家务词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握家庭成员称呼（mum, dad, grandma, grandpa, brother, sister）和家务相关词汇（help, cook, clean, wash, sweep, tidy, set the table 等）。

knowledge_points.name: 询问和表达家庭差异
knowledge_points.description: 能听懂、会说 How are families different? 并介绍自己家庭与别人家庭的不同（如有没有兄弟姐妹、宠物等）。

knowledge_points.name: 主动提供帮助的句型
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 Can I help you? / I can help you. / Let me help you. 等主动帮助家人的句型，并能做出回应。

knowledge_points.name: 祈使句与现在进行时初步
knowledge_points.description: 能使用祈使句（Clean the room.）和 I'm + v-ing 表达正在做的事情。

knowledge_points.name: Project：制作幸福家庭海报
knowledge_points.description: 能用英语描述家人和家务分工，完成"Make a poster of a happy family"项目，并进行简单展示。

knowledge_points.name: 朋友特征词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握描述朋友的词汇：tall, short, thin, strong, quiet, friendly, kind, funny 等。

knowledge_points.name: 介绍朋友的句型
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 He/She is ... / He/She has ... / His/Her name is ... 等介绍朋友的句型。

knowledge_points.name: 如何选择朋友
knowledge_points.description: 能围绕 How do we choose our friends? 表达自己的交友标准（如 kind, friendly, helpful）。

knowledge_points.name: 物主代词 his/her/their
knowledge_points.description: 能正确使用 his, her, their 描述朋友的特征和物品。

knowledge_points.name: Project：制作朋友之书
knowledge_points.description: 能用英语写一段介绍朋友的小短文，完成"Make a book about your friend"项目。

knowledge_points.name: 社区场所词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握社区场所词汇：park, school, shop, hospital, library, playground, bus stop 等。

knowledge_points.name: 描述社区环境的句型
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 There is/are ... 句型描述社区里有什么，并能回答 What can we see in a community? 和 What do people do in a community?。

knowledge_points.name: 方位介词
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 in, on, near, next to, behind, in front of 等方位介词描述场所位置。

knowledge_points.name: 社区职业与活动
knowledge_points.description: 了解社区中人们的活动（play, work, shop, exercise）和职业（doctor, teacher, shopkeeper）。

knowledge_points.name: Project：制作梦想社区模型
knowledge_points.description: 能用英语规划并描述自己的梦想社区，完成"Make a dream community model"项目。

knowledge_points.name: 社区职业词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握常见职业词汇：doctor, nurse, teacher, police officer, firefighter, shop assistant, driver。

knowledge_points.name: 询问职业的句型
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 What's his/her job? He/She is a ... 询问和回答职业。

knowledge_points.name: 青少年帮助社区的表达
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 I can help by ... / We can ... 表达年轻人能为社区做的事（如帮助老人、捡垃圾、浇花）。

knowledge_points.name: 一般现在时第三人称单数
knowledge_points.description: 初步掌握 He/She works/helps ... 中动词的第三人称单数形式。

knowledge_points.name: Project：制作校园帮助者海报
knowledge_points.description: 能用英语介绍学校里的帮助者及其工作，完成"Make a poster of your school helpers"项目。

knowledge_points.name: 天气词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握天气词汇：sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, snowy, hot, cold, warm, cool。

knowledge_points.name: 询问天气的句型
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 What's the weather like? It's ... 询问和描述天气。

knowledge_points.name: 不同天气的活动
knowledge_points.description: 能表达不同天气下做什么：We can ... in sunny weather. / I wear ... when it's rainy. 等。

knowledge_points.name: 天气与生活的关联
knowledge_points.description: 理解天气对穿衣、出行、活动的影响，能根据天气做出合理选择。

knowledge_points.name: Project：制作恶劣天气提醒
knowledge_points.description: 能用英语制作恶劣天气（台风、暴雨、高温）的安全提醒，完成"Make a bad weather reminder"项目。

knowledge_points.name: 季节与服装词汇
knowledge_points.description: 掌握四季词汇（spring, summer, autumn, winter）和服装词汇（coat, sweater, T-shirt, dress, shorts, scarf, gloves）。

knowledge_points.name: 不同季节穿着的表达
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 We wear ... in ... / I put on ... 等表达不同季节的穿着。

knowledge_points.name: 不同季节活动的表达
knowledge_points.description: 能表达不同季节的活动：We go swimming in summer. / We make a snowman in winter. 等。

knowledge_points.name: 一般现在时的综合运用
knowledge_points.description: 综合运用一般现在时描述季节、天气、穿着和活动。

knowledge_points.name: Project：制作旅行卡
knowledge_points.description: 能用英语推荐季节和旅行目的地，完成"Make a travel card"项目。
